fields.description: WooCommerce refund id — the idempotency key. A re-delivered webhook carrying the same id must never book the refund twice.
fields.label: Woo Refund ID

fields.description: Absolute amount WooCommerce refunded for this refund id (Woo reports it negative; stored positive here). The net booked on the Sales Invoice is order_total minus the sum of these.
fields.label: Refund Amount

fields.description: Sales tax WooCommerce gave back in this refund (line, shipping and fee taxes), from the refund's own breakdown. Reverses the Woo tax row on the Sales Invoice instead of discounting the goods.
fields.label: Tax Refunded

fields.description: Shipping WooCommerce gave back in this refund (shipping lines, before tax). Reduces the invoice's shipping instead of discounting the goods.
fields.label: Shipping Refunded

fields.description: Fetched: tax/shipping come from WooCommerce's refund breakdown. Pending: not read yet — the whole refund books as a goods discount (the old way) until the reconcile job reads it. Not in Woo: WooCommerce did not list this refund; Rejected: its breakdown did not add up — both book the old way, were alerted, and are not read again. Blank: recorded before breakdowns were read; never read.
fields.options:
Fetched
Pending
Not in Woo
Rejected
fields.label: Breakdown

fields.description: When the POS recorded this refund from a WooCommerce webhook / reconcile.
fields.label: Recorded On
